company.name: Wingman
company.shortDescription: Wingman offers software solutions for digital marketing and web development, supporting business growth.
company.description: Wingman DX provides strategic digital transformation services, focusing on AI integration, marketing strategies, brand development, and web design. Their approach includes offering fractional executive services such as Chief Digital Officer, Chief AI Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, and Chief Branding Officer to assist businesses in implementing digital tools, automating processes, and enhancing customer engagement. Wingman DX also supports clients in securing government funding to offset planning and execution costs. Their services encompass AI and automation strategies, data analytics, CRM optimization, SEO, content marketing, paid advertising, brand positioning, visual identity, and custom website development. By aligning technology, branding, marketing, and web development, Wingman DX aims to help businesses improve operational efficiency and drive growth.
